# Region (`region` v1)

A region: population, income, unemployment, education, health and how it voted.

**Group:** Politics and society · **Mnemonic:** `REGN` · **Identifiers:** `REGN-…` in `regionId`

Open one with `REGN <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: region
version: 1
description: "A region: population, income, unemployment, education, health and how it voted."
match: { kind: region, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Politics and society · Region, id: $.regionId }
strip:
  - { label: Region, bind: $.name, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Population (m), bind: $.populationM, fmt: price2 }
  - { label: Median income, bind: $.medianIncome, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Unemployment, bind: $.unemployment, fmt: pct2 }
  - { label: Life expectancy, bind: $.lifeExpectancy, fmt: price2 }
panels:
  - id: vote
    kind: hbar
    title: Vote share at the last election
    key: F2
    rows: $.vote
    label: party
    value: share
    fmt: pct0
  - id: unemploymentTrend
    kind: line
    title: Unemployment rate
    area: right
    rows: $.unemploymentTrend
    x: year
    y: rate
    fmt: pct2
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.jurisdiction, 'jurisdiction')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
